name: zone-arc
title: Zone Arc
description: A reading on a half dial of coloured zones: zones sweep in, a marker swings over and its zone lights up.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas. The sweep and marker run on the UI thread on arrival and on change. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The dial appears whole, the marker jumps to its place and the number does not count.
a11y.screenReader: One label ("86 AQI, zone 2 of 4, 4 min ago").

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { ZoneArc } from '@/components/kinetik/zone-arc';

<ZoneArc
  value={86}
  min={0}
  zones={[
    { to: 50, color: 'hsl(145, 76%, 44%)' },
    { to: 100, color: 'hsl(50, 90%, 50%)' },
    { to: 150, color: 'hsl(28, 90%, 50%)' },
    { to: 200, color: 'hsl(350, 72%, 44%)' },
  ]}
  unit="AQI"
  ago="4 min ago"
/>;
```

## When to use

- A reading with named ranges: air quality, noise, battery health.
- When being in the right zone matters more than the exact figure.

## When not to use

- Colour alone cannot carry the meaning: pair it with a word if the zones have names.
- Values with no zones. Use Gauge Meter.

## Notes

- Each zone runs from the previous `to` up to its own.
- The zone holding the value is lit and the rest are dimmed.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add zone-arc`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
